problem: Separate morphology-independent manipulation intentions from robot-specific kinematic execution for cross-embodiment transfer.
contribution: CrossZero combines object-masked multi-view point clouds and shared end-effector diffusion with a separately adapted end-effector-to-joint diffusion module.
algorithm: Mask robot points, encode1024RGBXYZpoints with PointNet and fuse end-effector state. Train chunked first-level diffusion with an auxiliary object-pose loss. Train a second diffusion on end-effector/current-joint inputs using demonstration pairs in-domain or simulator-generated traditional-IK pairs for new robots.
observations: Multi-view calibrated RGBD/object masks, end-effector state and current joints; the second stage is embodiment-specific and is not inferred from an image alone.
actions: First stage predicts16Dend-effector sequences; second generates morphology-specific joint sequences. Predict8actions and execute5 per rollout chunk according to the source setup.
embodiment_and_data: RoboTwin simulation, aloha-agilex/franka-panda/ur5-wsg,200episodes across two training embodiments. New-robot IK module uses50episodes explicitly described as evaluation data; no physical validation is reported.
experiments: Leave-one-embodiment-out simulated tasks, masked/full/multiview/pose ablations and in/out-of-domain joint-decoder adaptation. Main text describes8tasks but principal table lists7task groups; baseline view descriptions are also inconsistent and require code clarification.
baselines: Full-Single-P/DP3-style baseline, shared object-centric ee policy with traditional IK and learned-IK variant. This changes representation/view/auxiliary objectives as well as decoder architecture.

limitations: The full adapted system is not training-free zero-shot: target-specific IK distillation uses50episodes, and disjointness from final evaluation is not established in examined text. Only discrete simulated embodiments tested; systematic physical validation and uncertainty adaptation are future work.
code_and_license: Primary method/evaluation examined; executable source and code/model/dataset rights not audited, no local CrossZero execution claimed.
